name: Elisabeth
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament

points: When his ministration was done he departed to his own house, and after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived; the text never says he lay with her, and no one questions how she conceived.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: In the sixth month of Elisabeth the same Gabriel came to Nazareth to a virgin espoused to Joseph of the house of David, Solomon's line; he came in and talked to her, nothing more.

Thy cousin Elisabeth hath also conceived a son in her old age, for with God nothing shall be impossible; also means the same way, and the impossible thing is a barren old woman bearing, not a birth without a father.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Mary was not yet pregnant when the angel left; she went with haste into the hill country to Zacharias's house, and the babe leaped in Elisabeth's womb.

Mary abode with Elisabeth about three months, until the birth, and returned to her own house in Nazareth, where Joseph was; Zacharias, his mouth opened, called the child the prophet of the Highest as Christ is the son of the Highest, and both children grew and waxed strong in spirit: the two births are told in parallel.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

cases.name: Zacharias and Elisabeth
cases.charge: Both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless
cases.preview: Zacharias was a priest of the course of Abia and Elisabeth was of the daughters of Aaron, and they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless;
